summary: Fire cover reduced at EGUN to three vehicles carrying 6,000 gallons of extinguishing agent.
text:
RFFS CAPABILITY RED, 03 VEHICLES/6000 GALLONS OF AGENT REDUCING 
THE LVL OF SER. RFFS IS A REDUCED LEVEL OF SER FOR NATIONAL FIRE 
PROTECTION ASSOCIATION (NFPA) CAT 8 (KC-135,  C-17, KC-46, B-1, B-2, 
B-52, 767). NFPA CAT 9 (KC-10, E-4, MD-11, 747, 777, VC-25) AND NFPA 
CAT 10 (C5, 787-8I) ARE AT REDUCED LVL OF SER. NFPA CAT 7 (RC-135, 
CV-22, C-130) REMAIN OPTIMUM LEVEL OF SER.
